audit.name: Clay tokens

prereqAssessment.why: Most Near Eastern tokens are baked clay; firing makes the counters durable enough to be kept, stored and enclosed in bullae.
One-mark-one-unit counting (Lebombo, Ishango) is the abstraction a token generalises to commodity-specific counters.

audit.ageGap: A2 node; prerequisites: fire_making A1, tally_notation A1.

effectsProposed.why: Counted stores (tokens in bullae for grain, oil and livestock) can be rationed and redistributed in a lean year instead of being consumed blindly.

audit.costConcern: 620 is the A2 floor; correct for a cheap enabling notation with six dependents.
audit.rationale: Causal prerequisites correct (Schmandt-Besserat token thesis). The capability is stores accounting, so the effect sits on famine relief rather than on yield.

audit.name: Stamp seal

prereqAssessment.why: Seals are carved and ground stone; the grinding and drilling repertoire of ground-edge tools is the working technique.
Sealings are impressions in clay on jars, bales and storeroom doors; a clay-working tradition is the medium (Halaf sealings on vessel stoppers).

audit.ageGap: A2 node; prerequisites: ground_stone_early A1, pottery_open_fired A2.

effectsProposed.why: Sealed storerooms and jar stoppers (Arslantepe, Tepe Gawra door sealings) expose tampering, cutting the share of stored grain lost to pilfering and unrecorded drawdown.

audit.costConcern: 880 suits an A2 two-prerequisite micro.
audit.rationale: Prerequisites correct. inst.archive is not live, so the node needs an operand effect; storeroom sealing reduces store losses.

audit.name: Proto-cuneiform

prereqAssessment.why: Proto-cuneiform signs for commodities and numbers derive from the token repertoire impressed on bullae (Uruk IV).

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: token_counting A2.

effectsProposed.why: Uruk ration lists and dues tablets let the temple-state record what each household owes and has paid, raising what a levy actually collects.

audit.costConcern: 1,760 is right for a one-prerequisite A3 extension of an A2 notation.
audit.rationale: Single causal prerequisite is the accepted derivation; effect is fiscal accounting, its documented use.

audit.name: Cuneiform (full writing)

prereqAssessment.why: Full cuneiform grew directly out of proto-cuneiform by phonetic (rebus) extension (~2,900 BCE).

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: proto_writing A3.

effectsProposed.why: Letters and written orders (Mari, Amarna archives) let a capital instruct governors far away, extending administrative reach.

audit.costConcern: 3,520 equals the other primary scripts; under the Age sweep all four A3 scripts must be completed before A5, so the group spends ~14,080 on scripts (see findings).
audit.rationale: Correct derivation. Library and school are live; the operand captures the specific use of cuneiform for long-distance correspondence.

audit.name: Egyptian hieroglyphic

prereqAssessment.why: Egyptian writing begins as commodity labels and numerals (Abydos U-j tags); a record-of-quantity tradition is the shared precursor, whether independent or stimulus-diffused.

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: token_counting A2.

effectsProposed.why: The Egyptian state rested on an office-holding scribal class ('be a scribe', Satire of the Trades); a script with ~700 signs sustains a larger literate specialist stratum.

audit.costConcern: 3,520, as the other primary scripts; see the sweep note on cuneiform.
audit.rationale: Prerequisite acceptable and does not force a Mesopotamian dependency for an Egyptian route. Effect differs from cuneiform (reach) by being the specialist-class capacity.

audit.name: Oracle bone script

prereqAssessment.why: Numerals and count marks precede and survive into oracle-bone numerals; the generic notation precursor.
The medium is prepared scapulae and plastrons, drilled and inscribed; bone-working is the material technique.

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: tally_notation A1, bone_tools A1. Gap of two or more Ages on tally_notation, bone_tools: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Divination records kept systematically (including dated eclipse and weather entries) begin the longest continuous written record of observation.

audit.costConcern: 3,520 as the other primary scripts. Emergence ~1,250 BCE sits at the A3/A4 boundary; A3 is kept because the script presupposes a long unattested development.
audit.rationale: Independent East Asian origin is correctly not routed through Mesopotamia. Effect is the observational record, distinct from the other scripts.

audit.name: Papyrus

prereqAssessment.why: Papyrus sheets are laid, crossed pith strips pressed together; the plant-fibre laying and weaving craft is the technique.

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: basketry A1. Gap of two or more Ages on basketry: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.
audit.costConcern: 880 is cheap for a writing surface, appropriate: it is a material, not a script.
audit.rationale: A genuine OR route to building.library (an alternative to the scripts and paper). Paper is independent of papyrus, so no dependent is missing.

audit.name: Consonantal alphabet

prereqAssessment.why: The Ugaritic alphabet is written in cuneiform signs; Levantine scribes trained in cuneiform administered the alphabet's world.
Proto-Sinaitic signs are acrophonic adaptations of Egyptian hieroglyphs (Serabit el-Khadim, ~1,800 BCE).
No path from the Chinese logographic system to a consonantal alphabet exists; East Asia never produced an abjad from it. The OR branch is a gameplay shortcut, not a derivation.

audit.ageGap: A4 node; prerequisites: cuneiform A3, hieroglyphic A3, chinese_script A3.

effectsProposed.why: Twenty-odd signs learnable in weeks put writing within reach of merchants and artisans, so commoners rise into literate occupations faster.

audit.costConcern: 3,520 is fair for the A4 landmark of cheap literacy.
audit.rationale: Drop chinese_script from the OR: the alphabet derives from Egyptian hieroglyphs via Proto-Sinaitic, with cuneiform as the parallel Levantine scribal tradition. A Chinese-script player loses nothing reachable: both remaining atoms are A3 and the A5 sweep requires them anyway.

audit.name: Alphabet with vowels

prereqAssessment.why: The Greek alphabet is the Phoenician abjad with consonant signs reassigned to vowels (~800 BCE).

audit.ageGap: A4 node; prerequisites: abjad A4.

effectsProposed.why: Full phonemic writing of a vernacular carried Homer, drama, history and philosophy into a reading citizenry: civic thought is written down and argued over.

audit.costConcern: 2,490 for a one-step extension is fair.
audit.rationale: Correct derivation. Its dependents (philosophical_schools, public_theatre, state_gazette) are civic, so the effect is on Civics Points.

audit.name: Brahmi script

prereqAssessment.why: The majority view derives Brahmi from Aramaic (an abjad) with added vowel diacritics; the alternative independent origin is noted in desc.

audit.ageGap: A4 node; prerequisites: abjad A4.

effectsProposed.why: Ashoka's rock and pillar edicts proclaimed conciliation and dhamma to subjects in their own Prakrits after Kalinga; written public address calms grievance.

audit.costConcern: 880 is cheap for an A4 node; acceptable because it is a derivative script, but it should not be cheaper than the A3 papyrus by rescaling.
audit.rationale: Prerequisite reflects the mainstream derivation. Effect captures its first and best-attested use: public edicts.

audit.name: Weighed silver

prereqAssessment.why: Silver money is silver by weight; the shekel standard is the measure.
Cupellation yields refined silver of reliable fineness, which is what makes cut silver acceptable by weight.

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: standard_weights A3, cupellation A3.

effectsProposed.why: A common, divisible measure of value lets traders settle any exchange without matching barter wants, so price gaps between settlements close faster (Old Assyrian silver accounts).

audit.costConcern: 2,960 is fair for A3 with two A3 prerequisites.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Placed in the communication lane with money; effect is exchange efficiency.

audit.name: Coinage

prereqAssessment.why: Coins are weighed silver (or electrum) whose weight is guaranteed in advance; hacksilver is the money they replace.
A coin is a metal blank struck with an authenticating stamp; the die is a seal.

audit.ageGap: A4 node; prerequisites: hacksilver A3, stamp_seal A2. Gap of two or more Ages on stamp_seal: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Taxes assessed and paid in coin instead of kind are cheaper to collect, move and audit (Persian and Greek tribute in coin).
Counted coin of known fineness removes weighing and assay from every exchange, adding to the gap-closing that weighed silver began.

audit.costConcern: 11,830 is the most expensive A4 communication node by far; justified as a landmark with a live building and two effects, but the calibration should check it against abjad (3,520).
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Mint is live; coin taxation and market exchange are its two documented consequences.

audit.name: Paper

prereqAssessment.why: Paper is macerated plant fibre (hemp rag, bark, ramie); processing fibre into cordage and cloth supplies the raw material and the retting craft.

audit.ageGap: A5 node; prerequisites: cordage A1. Gap of two or more Ages on cordage: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Cheap paper let the Han and later Tang bureaucracies keep registers, reports and correspondence at a scale no clay, silk or bamboo could, extending administrative reach.

audit.costConcern: 11,830 is high for A5 but paper is a landmark with two live buildings.
audit.rationale: Prerequisite is the causal material craft. Effect is administrative scale (its desc: bureaucratic scale).

audit.name: Woodblock printing

prereqAssessment.why: Block printing needs a cheap absorbent sheet; it took off only on paper.
Carved relief impressed in ink is the seal principle at page scale; Chinese seals and rubbings are the direct precursor.

audit.ageGap: A6 node; prerequisites: paper A5, stamp_seal A2. Gap of two or more Ages on stamp_seal: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Song printed agricultural manuals (Chen Fu's Nongshu, 1149) and state calendars spread better practice and timing to ordinary farmers.

audit.costConcern: 14,070 is high relative to the later and more consequential types (3,520 and 2,490); acceptable as the A6 landmark that carries the printing house.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Effect is the diffusion of farm technique by print, its best-documented economic use in Song China.

audit.name: Ceramic movable type

prereqAssessment.why: Bi Sheng's type is an extension of block printing: same paper, ink and rubbing, with the block split into reusable characters.
The type is baked clay; firing clay to hardness is the material step.

audit.ageGap: A6 node; prerequisites: woodblock_print A6, kiln_updraft A2. Gap of two or more Ages on kiln_updraft: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Reusable type made short runs of scholarly works economic (Shen Kuo records the method for this purpose), a modest gain to recorded learning.

audit.costConcern: 3,520 for a niche technique is fair.
audit.rationale: Correct derivation. Historically limited by character count, so its effect is small.

audit.name: Metal movable type

prereqAssessment.why: Goryeo metal type extends the movable-type principle to cast bronze.
Type is cast in closed moulds (sand moulds in Korea); closed-mould casting is the metal technique.

audit.ageGap: A6 node; prerequisites: movable_type_ceramic A6, casting_closed A3. Gap of two or more Ages on casting_closed: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Goryeo and Joseon state presses printed the Confucian classics and examination texts in many copies, widening access to the study that led to office.

audit.costConcern: 2,490 is fair.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Deliberate leaf: European type founding was independent, so no edge to printing_press is justified.

audit.name: Paper money

prereqAssessment.why: Jiaozi and later notes were block-printed with multiple colour plates to resist forgery.
Notes began as receipts for deposited coin; a coin standard is what they promised.

audit.ageGap: A6 node; prerequisites: woodblock_print A6, coinage_electrum A4. Gap of two or more Ages on coinage_electrum: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Money not limited by metal supply relieved the Song coin shortage, so goods held for want of a medium of exchange reached the market faster.

audit.costConcern: 4,970 fair.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. inst.central_bank is not live, so an operand carries it; the documented effect is monetary liquidity.

audit.name: Bill of exchange

prereqAssessment.why: A bill promises payment in a named coin elsewhere; it presupposes coin standards to convert between.
Alphabetic commercial literacy (Arabic suftaja, Italian merchant hands) is the medium of the instrument.
The Tang 'flying money' (feiqian, ~800 CE) is the East Asian draft; the OR keeps that independent route.

audit.ageGap: A6 node; prerequisites: coinage_electrum A4, abjad A4, chinese_script A3. Gap of two or more Ages on coinage_electrum, abjad, chinese_script: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Payment across distance without moving coin let merchant networks arbitrage distant markets with less risk and capital tied up (Champagne fairs, Italian banking houses).

audit.costConcern: 3,520 fair.
audit.rationale: Prerequisites correct; the OR on literacy preserves the Islamic/Italian and Chinese routes.

audit.name: Printing press

prereqAssessment.why: The adjustable hand mould and type-metal alloy are the core of Gutenberg's system.
The screw press (wine and oil presses) is the press mechanism.
Cheap paper made press runs economic; vellum copies were the exception.

audit.ageGap: A7 node; prerequisites: type_founding A7, mechanics_archimedean A5, paper A5. Gap of two or more Ages on mechanics_archimedean, paper: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Identical, cheap, correctable texts let results accumulate and be checked across Europe (Eisenstein); a landmark gain to research.
Pamphlets and vernacular books created the public sphere of the Reformation and after.

audit.costConcern: 28,130 is the A7 communication landmark; fair.
audit.rationale: All three causal components are present. Landmark node with two moderated research effects (research-coefficient caps are tight, see findings).

audit.name: Electric telegraph

prereqAssessment.why: Needle and Morse instruments are electromagnets driven by a battery current.
Long lines need drawn iron and copper wire by the hundreds of kilometres.

audit.ageGap: A8 node; prerequisites: electromagnetism A8, wire_drawing A6. Gap of two or more Ages on wire_drawing: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: Prices known instantly across markets collapsed regional price gaps (US grain and cotton markets after the 1840s-60s telegraph).

audit.costConcern: 66,910 is high vs telephone (9,950) but the telegraph is the A8 landmark of the lane.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Optical telegraph is not a prerequisite (electrical telegraphy did not derive from semaphore). Effect is the measured price-convergence consequence.

audit.name: Submarine telegraph cable

prereqAssessment.why: The cable carries telegraph signalling.
Cable-laying needs powered ships able to hold course and pay out cable (Great Eastern, 1866).

audit.ageGap: A8 node; prerequisites: telegraph A8, steamboat A8.

effectsProposed.why: Cable links let a capital govern across oceans in hours rather than months (the imperial 'All-Red Line'), extending administrative reach.

audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites; gutta-percha insulation has no node and is subsumed. Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Telephone

prereqAssessment.why: Bell worked on a harmonic telegraph; the telephone reuses telegraph lines, batteries and electromagnetic transducers.

audit.ageGap: A8 node; prerequisites: telegraph A8.
audit.costConcern: 9,950 is low for an A8 node with a live infrastructure; acceptable as an extension of the telegraph.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisite. The live telephone network is its effect.

audit.name: Artificial satellite

prereqAssessment.why: Reaching orbit is the defining step.
Orbit determination, tracking and telemetry reduction ran on ground computers from 1957.
Sputnik 1 used valves, but practical satellites (Explorer 1, Vanguard 1) depended on transistor electronics for weight and power; dated 1947, it is no chronology problem.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: orbital_launch_vehicle A9, computer A9, transistor A9.

effectsProposed.why: Orbital reconnaissance lets an Explore order point at distant ground: a pointed observer extending range, not a map reveal (D-039 B3, D-040 B3).

audit.costConcern: 378,470 is the most expensive node in the group and has no live entity; the calibration should check it against communications_satellite (94,620) and the A9 scale.
audit.rationale: Prerequisites correct. Integer operand: the delta only bites with others; chosen because observation range is the satellite's direct capability.

audit.name: Wireless telegraphy (radio)

prereqAssessment.why: Maxwell's waves, demonstrated by Hertz, are what Marconi transmitted.
Wireless telegraphy kept telegraph code, keys and operators; it was conceived as telegraphy without wires.

audit.ageGap: A8 node; prerequisites: electromagnetic_field_theory A8, telegraph A8.
audit.costConcern: 66,900 equals telegraph; fair.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. The live transmitter building is its effect.

audit.name: Television

prereqAssessment.why: Television is broadcast transmission carrying a picture signal; same transmitters and receivers lineage.
Photosensitive surfaces and optics (camera tube) are the image-capture side.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: radio_broadcasting A9, photography A8.

effectsProposed.why: Home entertainment and a shared national picture of events absorbed leisure and discontent (a modern 'bread and circuses').

audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. inst.mass_media_broadcast is not live; grievance relief is the operand it causally touches.

audit.name: Internet

prereqAssessment.why: Hosts and packet switches (IMPs) are computers.
ARPANET ran on leased telephone lines and modems.
IMPs (Honeywell DDP-516) and later routers were IC machines.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: computer A9, telephone A8, integrated_circuit A9.

effectsProposed.why: Shared papers, data and remote computing among researchers worldwide raise research output per person.

audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Live backbone plus a research effect.

audit.name: Cellular telephony

prereqAssessment.why: Cellular handsets are two-way radio transceivers.
Handset and base-station control and handoff logic run on microprocessors.
Cellular networks are switched telephone networks with automatic handoff.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: radio_broadcasting A9, microprocessor A9, automatic_switching A8.

effectsProposed.why: Phones in every hand narrow price dispersion between markets (Kerala fish markets, Jensen 2007).

audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Live network plus measured market-integration effect.

audit.name: Optical fibre

prereqAssessment.why: Fibre links are driven by lasers (and LEDs); the laser is the coherent source.
No fused-silica node exists; lead crystal stands for the optical-glass lineage (flint glass, Guinand/Fraunhofer). Imperfect material proxy, flagged rather than changed.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: laser A9, glass_lead A7. Gap of two or more Ages on glass_lead: a deep foundational input, not a reason to change the edge.

effectsProposed.why: High-bandwidth research backbones (NSFNET, JANET) let universities share instruments, data and computing, lowering the cost of research they host.

audit.rationale: Prerequisites acceptable. Missing bridge: fibre is the backbone of cloud_computing (2006) data centres; recommend the engineering-lane owner consider it (see findings). Internet cannot take it (1969 < 1970).

audit.name: Digital cellular networks

prereqAssessment.why: Digital generations replace analogue cellular on the same network model.
Digital signal processing in handsets needs VLSI CMOS chips.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: mobile_phone A9, cmos_vlsi A9.

effectsProposed.why: Mobile data and money (M-Pesa) let households receive remittances within hours of a shock, absorbing shortfalls (Jack and Suri 2014).

audit.costConcern: 8,360 is very cheap for A9; acceptable as an extension.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Effect is the measured risk-sharing consequence of mobile money.

audit.name: Climate engineering

prereqAssessment.why: Atmospheric remediation scales out of industrial capture of CO2.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: carbon_capture A9.

effectsProposed.why: Each level of remediation damps climate extremes, steadying harvests; as a repeatable this should be authored as a gapFraction on the same operand (contract §4).

audit.costConcern: 23,650 base with level growth per §4; fine.
audit.rationale: Repeatable end-of-tree node; operand chosen as the farm-visible consequence of climate stabilisation.

audit.name: Trade
audit.prereq: token_counting AND (donkey OR camel OR sail_square)

prereqAssessment.why: Exchange at a counted standard needs a record of quantity.
Donkey caravans carried the Uruk and Old Assyrian trade.
OR alternative carrier; its later date is harmless because the OR is not must-held.
OR alternative: boat trade (Gulf, Nile).

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: token_counting A2, donkey A3, camel A3, sail_square A3.
audit.costConcern: 880 is cheap for the activity that opens inter-settlement trade; deliberate so trade is not delayed.
audit.rationale: Causal prerequisites and the carrier OR are right. activity.trade is its live effect.

audit.name: Mesoamerican writing

prereqAssessment.why: Mesoamerican writing emerges from calendar notation (day signs and bar-and-dot numerals).

audit.ageGap: A3 node; prerequisites: calendar_lunar A2.

effectsProposed.why: Dated dynastic stelae proclaimed the ruler's descent and calendrical legitimacy to the public plaza.

audit.costConcern: 3,520 as the other primary scripts; emerged ~650 BCE is in A4's window although Aged A3 (see findings).
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisite. Age label A3 is earlier than its attested emergence (~650 BCE); left as is because it is a regional OR route to library and school and moving it would lengthen that route.

audit.name: Optical telegraph

prereqAssessment.why: Chappe operators read the next tower's arms through telescopes.

audit.ageGap: A7 node; prerequisites: telescope A7.

effectsProposed.why: A state semaphore network put Paris within hours of its frontiers, extending the reach of central command.

audit.costConcern: 7,030 fair.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisite. Deliberate leaf: electrical telegraphy did not derive from semaphore.

audit.name: Automatic telephone switching

prereqAssessment.why: Strowger switching connects telephone subscribers.

audit.ageGap: A8 node; prerequisites: telephone A8.

effectsProposed.why: Dial service made calling cheap and immediate at scale, so wholesalers and retailers order and clear stock without operator delay.

audit.costConcern: 9,950 fair.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisite. Also a bridge to programmable_computer (relay logic).

audit.name: Punched-card tabulation

prereqAssessment.why: Punched cards as machine-readable records come from the Jacquard loom.
Hollerith's reader closed electrical circuits through the holes to drive electromagnetic counters: telegraph-era electrical engineering.

audit.ageGap: A8 node; prerequisites: jacquard A8, telegraph A8.

effectsProposed.why: Machine tabulation of census and property records (US 1890 census) gives complete, current registers on which assessments and collection rest.

audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Missing bridge: punched-card input/output fed early programmable computers (Harvard Mark I, ENIAC); recommend programmable_computer accept it as an OR alternative (engineering-lane owner).

audit.name: Communications satellite

prereqAssessment.why: A relay satellite is an orbital satellite.
Telstar and Syncom were solar powered.

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: satellite A9, solar_pv A9.

effectsProposed.why: Satellite relay reached remote islands and interiors with no cable (Indonesia's Palapa, 1976, built for national integration).

audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Voice radio and broadcasting

prereqAssessment.why: Broadcasting is radio transmission to many receivers.
Voice modulation and amplification need valves (de Forest, Armstrong).

audit.ageGap: A9 node; prerequisites: radio A8, vacuum_tube A9.

effectsProposed.why: Governments could speak directly to every household in a crisis (fireside chats, emergency bulletins), shortening disorder and its cost to output.

audit.costConcern: 66,900 equals radio; fair.
audit.rationale: Correct prerequisites. The broadcast institution is not live; the operand is unrest management, its documented political use.

newNodes.name: Parchment codex
newNodes.emerged: ~170 BCE Pergamon parchment (traditional); ~85 CE Roman pocket codices (Martial); codex dominant by ~400 CE
newNodes.prereqRationale: Parchment is limed, scraped and stretched animal skin, a hide-working craft (hide_working, ~100 kya). The codex is the alphabetic literate world's book (abjad, ~1,800 BCE): Greek, Latin, Syriac and Hebrew scriptures and law. Both are older and from earlier Ages.
newNodes.desc: Pages of durable parchment bound between boards. A codex can be opened at any page, indexed and carried, so reference books, law codes and scripture survive and can be consulted quickly.
newNodes.distinctFrom: papyrus (A3) is the scroll writing surface and paper (A5) the cheap sheet material; this is the bound, page-addressable, long-lasting book format, so its effect is on accumulated knowledge, not on administrative scale.

newNodes.name: Sustained-yield forestry
newNodes.emerged: ~1,669 CE Colbert's French forest ordinance; ~1,713 CE Carlowitz, Sylvicultura oeconomica (Saxony)
newNodes.prereqRationale: Managed forests presuppose legal reserves and rights of cutting (forest_law, civic, ~1,079 CE). Cutting only the annual growth needs stands divided into measured compartments (surveying, ~2,500 BCE). Both are older and from earlier Ages.
newNodes.desc: Forests divided into measured plots, cut in rotation and replanted so that no more wood is taken each year than grows back. Timber and fuel stop running out.
newNodes.distinctFrom: forest_law (A6 civic) reserves forests by decree; this is the technical practice of rotation, measurement and replanting that raises the sustained timber harvest. It is the environment lane's first finite node.

newNodes.name: Steam-powered printing press
newNodes.emerged: 1814 CE (Koenig's steam cylinder press prints The Times); 1843 CE Hoe rotary press
newNodes.prereqRationale: The machine mechanises Gutenberg's process (printing_press, ~1,450 CE). It is driven by rotary steam power (steam_rotary, 1781 CE). Both are older and from earlier Ages.
newNodes.desc: Cylinder and then rotary presses driven by steam print thousands of sheets an hour. Daily newspapers sell for a penny, and politics, prices and news reach every reader.
newNodes.distinctFrom: printing_press (A7) is the hand press of books and pamphlets; this is the mechanised mass-circulation press behind the penny press (mass_press civic). It has no live building of its own, only the civic-discourse effect.

findings: Age sweep vs regional scripts: cuneiform, hieroglyphic, chinese_script and mesoamerican_script are OR alternatives for library, school and abjad, but the sweep makes every A3 node mandatory before A5, so a polity pays ~14,080 for four scripts. Each now has a distinct small effect so the forced completions are not dead weight. Consider whether the pacing scale should treat same-function alternatives as one cohort slot.

Research-coefficient caps are tight: research.researchPointsCoefficient and research.civicsPointsCoefficient cap at 0.3 for the whole tree. This group uses RP 0.17 (chinese_script 0.02, movable_type_ceramic 0.02, codex 0.03, printing_press 0.05, internet 0.05) and CP 0.09 (alphabet_vowels, printing_press, steam_printing_press 0.03 each). The integrator should sum across groups before calibration, because the clamp will silently flatten late nodes.

Media nodes moved off the research coefficients onto social operands where a mechanism exists: brahmi and mesoamerican_script (public edicts and stelae, grievanceRelief), television (grievanceRelief), radio_broadcasting (unrestOutputDrag), cellular_digital (foodState shortfall absorption via mobile money).

Communication-lane operand mix: authorityDecayCostUnits carries the 'command at distance' thread (cuneiform 0.04, paper 0.04, optical_telegraph 0.05, submarine_cable 0.06, communications_satellite 0.03 = 0.22 of cap 3.0). trade.gapClosingFraction carries the 'price information' thread (hacksilver, coinage, bill_of_exchange, telegraph, mobile_phone = 0.20 of cap 1.5).

Missing bridges for other owners: punched_card_tabulation is a leaf but fed programmable computers (Harvard Mark I, ENIAC card I/O), so programmable_computer could take it as an OR alternative. fibre_optics is a leaf but is the backbone of cloud_computing. steam_printing_press (new) is the causal technology of the mass_press civic (C5), which could add it. None of these were applied, since the edges belong to other lanes.

Chronology label: mesoamerican_script is Aged A3 but its earliest attestation (~650 BCE) is in A4's window, and chinese_script (~1,250 BCE) sits on the A3/A4 boundary. Both are kept in A3 as OR routes to library and school; moving them would lengthen those regional routes and change the sweep cohort.
fibre_optics depends on glass_lead (lead crystal), a proxy because no fused-silica or float-glass node exists. Kept, but a materials owner may want a modern-glass node.

The environment lane had one node (frontier_climate, repeatable A9). sustained_yield_forestry (A7) adds its first finite node. Later environmental technologies (catalytic_converter, carbon_capture) sit in the science lane and were not moved.

Satellite (378,470) is the most expensive node in the group with no live entity; its effect is an integer fog operand (fog.exploreMaxRadiusNodes 0.1) that only bites when summed with others. Flag for calibration.

One dependency change is proposed: abjad drops chinese_script from its OR, because no historical derivation exists. It is reachability-neutral because cuneiform and hieroglyphic are A3 and required by the A5 sweep anyway.
